_comment: This file contains the configuration for the models used in the application. Capability -> model per provider. Agents ask for a capability, never a model ID. OpenRouter slugs are best-effort; a wrong slug shows up as a logged gateway error, not a silent fallback. Override any entry with NEUTAIL_MODEL_<CAPABILITY>_<PROVIDER> in your environment variables. For example, NEUTAIL_MODEL_TEXT_DAVINCI_003=neutail/text-davinci-003
